# Miguel Osorio Gonzalez  
**Associate Director, Horizon Media** | *MS Business Analytics, Baruch College (exp. Summer 2026)*

Hi! I use **SQL** daily in my job, I have some working experience with **Python** and **R**, plus strong background in data visualization, mostly in **Tableau**. I returned to graduate school to sharpen my technical skills amid AI's rapid evolution while balancing a full-time role + 3 graduate courses. 

A personal goal of mine is to reach conversational level in **Mandarin** and **Portuguese** and become a polyglot. Currently, I am taking **Mandarin** classes in hopes that in the upcoming years I can visit and have a smooth time getting around and talking to the locals.

On this site, you'll find examples of my coursework, mini-projects from STA 9750, and hands-on work with R and Quarto exploring real-world datasets to answer practical questions and communicate actionable insights clearly.

You can connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguelosoriogonzalez/).
